== English Special Edition comparison ==
The printed front takes the indicator from the Reserve Deck and permits a flip after the matching system has been deployed. Decipher's January 2002 replacement retains the Reserve Deck as the source, requires deployment of five battleground systems and the Hidden Base system, and moves probing on the back from any draw phase to any deploy phase. The July 2010 PC announcement changes the front indicator source to outside your deck. The 2013 and 2017 slips and 2023 rulebook carry the later text. The [[:File:SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|Holotable front]] has the 2010 wording. The Decipher article uses its publisher text and displays the back whose game text matches the January 2002 replacement.
